thread:
ryan (sales): Hey team — FinBank POC hitting intermittent 5xxs during a demo. Demo load ~120 qps, started seeing 503s around 15:02 PST. Customer panicked. Can we triage?

sara (support): Ugh. Do you have request IDs or example timestamps? Any pattern (model, route)?

ryan (sales): Sending two request IDs in a sec. It's on the text-gen route using model=redwood-large-v1, 512 tokens, streaming off. Seen on both hosted and the dedicated preview pool.

ryan (sales): req=fb-req-20260321-1 and req=fb-req-20260321-2 

alex (infra): Got it. My guess: autoscale lag + burstpool exhaustion. 120 qps with 512 tokens -> sustained token churn, autoscaler might be slow to add nodes. Can someone paste the orchestrator logs?

james (eng-oncall): infra-bot just posted a scale alert around the same time: "scale_delay_threshold_exceeded: 00:01:40". That lines up.

infra-bot: ALERT: autoscaler-delay on pool=dedicated-us-west-2, surge=+3 requested, nodes_added=0, reason=quota-check-failed (rate-limit on API quota).

alex (infra): Ah, quota-check-failed — looks like the control-plane was rate-limited from a downstream quota. That prevents scale actions.

james (eng-oncall): Workaround while we clear the quota: 1) lower max_children/batch_size for this route, 2) enable the lighter model fallback for this customer (redwood-medium-q8).

linda (solutions): FYI sales — customer asked about reserved capacity pricing earlier. If they commit to dedicated capacity we can pre-warm nodes and avoid this scenario. I'll send pricing.

sara (support): Can you run this on the broken request and attach logs?

james (eng-oncall): Paste run command: 
```
kubectl logs -n inference pod/serve-xxxxx --since=10m | grep fb-req-20260321-1
```

alex (infra): Also check control plane quota: 
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/quotas | jq '.pools[\"dedicated-us-west-2\"]'
```

ryan (sales): Running logs now. Quick heads-up: customer security review is blocking if we suggest dedicated — they want KMS + SOC2 proof.

linda (solutions): We have KMS + SOC2 docs ready. I'll DM the questionnaire answers and the audit bundle.

sara (support): Root cause timeline: 15:01 scale requested, 15:02 control-plane quota returned 429, 15:03 demo traffic spiked -> 503s returned by frontdoor.

james (eng-oncall): Short term mitigation applied: reduced batch_size from 64->32 on that route, enabled fallback (redwood-medium-q8). 503s dropped within ~30s. We should still resolve quota throttle.

alex (infra): I opened internal ticket INF-8742 to increase control-plane quota for that customer project and add autoscaler retry logic.

ryan (sales): Thanks. Customer de-escalated, demo resumed. Can we capture a postmortem and a recommended POC config for finance customers (limits, reserved capacity suggestion, fallback model)? They want to avoid surprises.

sara (support): I'll draft a short postmortem and a POC checklist: recommended concurrency limits, suggested fallback models, reserved capacity guidance + how to request pre-warm.

linda (solutions): I'll attach the security bundle and reserved capacity pricing to Ryan.

james (eng-oncall): Action items: 1) INF-8742 for quota bump and autoscaler retry (alex), 2) update docs with POC checklist (sara), 3) postmortem note + timeline (sara), 4) sales followup with pricing + security bundle (linda/ryan).

ryan (sales): Perfect. ETA to have customer-ready doc? EOD tomorrow if possible.

sara (support): I'll have a draft by tomorrow 4pm PST.

alex (infra): I'll push a temporary quota increase and report back once control-plane confirms.

infra-bot: TICKET INF-8742 created by alex at 2200000028

ryan (sales): Appreciate it everyone :pray:

sara (support): Closing the loop: will update thread when postmortem is in the shared drive.

james (eng-oncall): If anyone needs the raw logs, ping me and I'll drop them to a secure share.

linda (solutions): Noted. I'll coordinate the security handoff after postmortem.

ryan (sales): Closing this thread for now. Will reopen if anything else pops up during their next demo.
